programmes.name: Full Body (1-Day)
programmes.full_description: One efficient full-body session a week covering hips, back, pressing and single-leg work, plus mobility, activation and a touch of power. The most time-friendly way to get stronger and stay injury-resistant.

programmes.name: Upper / Lower (2-Day)
programmes.full_description: One lower-body day and one upper-body day. Enough to build genuine strength and support your running, while leaving plenty of room for your miles.

programmes.name: Push / Pull / Legs (3-Day)
programmes.short_description: The classic push, pull, legs split.
programmes.full_description: Three sessions a week, one each for pushing, pulling and legs. More focused volume per area to build strength and power, with every day kept fresh and specific.

programmes.name: Upper / Lower / Full (3-Day)
programmes.full_description: An upper day, a lower day and a full-body day. A well-rounded week that spreads the work evenly and keeps your legs fresh for running.

programmes.name: Upper / Lower (4-Day)
programmes.full_description: Four days a week: two upper and two lower sessions, each with its own emphasis across chest, back, glutes, hamstrings and core. Serious strength for when you can give it four days.

programmes.name: Full Split (5-Day)
programmes.full_description: Push, pull and legs plus dedicated upper and lower days. Our most complete week for building strength and power, with the volume spread so nothing gets overcooked.
